name: San Bernardino County Youth Council (Friday Night Live)
org: San Bernardino County Department of Public Health
what_you_do: Speak up for teens across the county. You plan events, talk with local leaders and help other teens make healthy choices and grow as leaders.
who_can_apply: You must be an incoming 8th to 12th grader. You must live in San Bernardino County or go to a school in one of its districts. You also need a parent to say yes.
pay_detail: The application packet does not list pay. You pay for your own travel when needed.
duration: Full year. Two meetings a month, at least one hour each, in person and online.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 packet says the form is due by a specific date, but it gives no date. No date is posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Turn in the form, a letter of recommendation, references, parent consent and the signed agreement. Email them to allfnl@dph.sbcounty.gov or bring them in. Ask first if seats are open.
notes: You can miss no more than 3 required meetings. You must go to at least 5 meetings in person and join at least 2 community events. You also agree to live free of alcohol and drugs and to be in photos and video. Friday Night Live office: 909-387-9146.
